_comment: Local signature database for the virus scanner. Hash signatures are SHA-256 of known-bad files. Pattern signatures are byte/string indicators scanned inside files. This is a teaching database, not a production feed — extend it freely.

pattern_signatures.name: EICAR-Test-String
pattern_signatures.description: The literal EICAR test pattern — harmless, used to verify scanners work.

pattern_signatures.name: Heur.Eval-Base64-Decode
pattern_signatures.description: eval() wrapping a base64 decode — common in obfuscated PHP/JS droppers.

pattern_signatures.name: Heur.PowerShell-EncodedCommand
pattern_signatures.description: PowerShell launched with a hidden, base64-encoded command block.

pattern_signatures.name: Heur.Shell-Curl-Pipe-Bash
pattern_signatures.description: Pipe a remote script straight into a shell — classic dropper one-liner.

pattern_signatures.name: Heur.Windows-PE-In-Script
pattern_signatures.description: An MZ/PE header embedded inside a text/script file (dropped executable).
